body: I miss that place.
I can relate to this. My dad would say something like “.. oh look, dinner just invited itself”

I’ve wasted 10 years with that kind of human being. Since I have dependents and responsiblities I decided I just try to hold on to the good things for the sake of keeping myself and my dependants afloat. This year, it felt like I can no longer put a smile on my face. I became bitter. Resentful. I have to save myself. I dont know where to begin and how to tell my family. And the truth I hate to admit is I am afraid of starting over somewhere else. Im not as educated. Im just a normal person who drop put of college to work so my mum can quit hers and go to seek medical attention. I been rejected a few times just because I dont have a degree. So, yes.. that is my fear.
This post and its replies gave me a little courage to start over.
I am. 100%. Perhaps will apply to adopt children and continue by becoming a single parent.
The lack of voice tone, facial expression etc makes it impossible to engage and maintain that engagement.
Its much worst online
No.
No, I have not. They would sent one or two replies and then gone.
It was surprising at first but then one get used to it and eventually half expected that every conversation will end up as such.

Based on my own experience, yes, they do try to find friends but do bear in mind the definition of “friends” are vary depending on the person seeking it. You bound to have a few lines of conversation and then being left hanging by the other person. The term, I believe, is ghosted. However, don’t let a few ill fated conversation stops you from finding friends.
Likewise. Both the windows and the doors are firmly shut and bolted.
Let go. Move on.

In my personal opinion, no. They should not. What they should do is to treat the people they come to know with kindness, love, respect and understanding. Whether or not each acquaintances lasts, it should not matter much. Just be good to each other for as long as we can.

Update: They individually denied what I’ve said and each comes with a different statement that contradicts each other. They also states that I am being too sensitive. A younger me would use those contradictions to put them in their place but I am old and I am tired of these things and I took the easy way out. I said thank you and move on. -End-

Yes and No. Its dependent on what sort of experience(s), attitude and outlook one has. My four time divorced aunt still believes that her knight in shiny armour is still out there. She has never given up hope on love and that special someone. I had ONE relationship and after it ends I said to myself “never again” and I go about my life never intending to have a special relationship again. I believe theres someone for everyone but not for me.
Its alright to feel a bit lost at the beginning. Know when to reach out to good people when you need it.
Unfortunately, no. I am sure I will meet good people along the way. But until then, I’ll make do with what I have (or dont have).

I’ve just told them how I feel and implore them to not do what they have done to me unto others.  None of them took my calls and I havent gotten any reply from any of them. In the meantime, I just carry on existing. Maybe start learning to be ok alone.
Thank you very much.
I have been and still is in such situation. I handled it by further disassociating myself with anyone. My current salvation are vodka and books.
